summary.text: Ondu is one of the seven continents of Zendikar, a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and rivers.

bio.text: A civil war between Makindi and the Ondu Skyclave destroyed Makindi and ruined the Skyclave, which fell onto Jwar Isle.
Nahiri entered a ruined kor city there and found a carving of herself as a prophet, and she collapsed the building.
After the Eldrazi titans were released their broods filled Ondu, but the land resisted them with crystalline shards, canyons and mesas that grow limbs.
It is home to the relic hunter Javad Nasrin.

status.text: The latest material, from a 2022 card, still describes it as a plateau continent crisscrossed by trenches and rivers.
